emails.subject: BankID on my new phone still does not work
emails.body: I ordered a new BankID on 10 November and it still cannot be activated in the app. I cannot pay my bills.
emails.backend_status: BankID re-issued 14 Nov; activation code sent by letter, due 16 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your new BankID was issued on 14 November and the activation code is on its way by letter, due on 16 November. Until then you can pay bills at any kontor or through the Kundcenter. We are sorry for the wait. We will send you our decision once this is done. If you are not satisfied with it, you can ask our Kundombudsman (Customer Ombudsman) to review it, and after that apply to ARN.

emails.subject: Swish failed but the money left my account
emails.body: A Swish payment failed on 11 November but the money was still taken from my account. It has not come back. I have already complained once.
emails.backend_status: Payment returned 13 Nov, 17:05, two days after the debit. Any redress for the delay: confirm with the bank.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The Swish payment that failed on 11 November was returned to your account on 13 November at 17:05. We are sorry it took longer than it should have. If the delay cost you a fee, please reply to this message and we will look into it. If you are not satisfied with this decision, you can ask our Kundombudsman (Customer Ombudsman) to review it, and after that apply to ARN (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, the National Board for Consumer Disputes).

emails.subject: On behalf of the account holder: account restricted after the customer questions
emails.body: Writing as the account holder's legal guardian (god man). The customer questions were answered at the kontor on 6 November. The account is still restricted. Please advise.
emails.backend_status: Account-measure review completed 13 Nov; restriction lifted 13 Nov, 16:30.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The review of the account was completed on 13 November and the restriction was lifted the same day at 16:30. Payments and Swish work again. We will also write to the account holder in the internet bank. If you are not satisfied with this decision, you can ask our Kundombudsman (Customer Ombudsman) to review it, and after that apply to ARN (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, the National Board for Consumer Disputes).
emails.theme_label: Account measures: frozen or restricted accounts

emails.subject: My bolån promise expires before access day
emails.body: My loan promise (lånelöfte) expires on 21 November and access day has moved to December. Can it be extended?
emails.backend_status: Extension approved 14 Nov; new loan promise to be issued 17 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your loan promise has been extended to cover the new access day, and the new promise will be issued on 17 November. You will find it in the internet bank and the app. We will send you our decision once this is done. If you are not satisfied with it, you can ask our Kundombudsman (Customer Ombudsman) to review it, and after that apply to ARN.

emails.subject: ISK transfer from another bank not received
emails.body: I moved my ISK from another bank on 3 November. The holdings have left there but nothing shows in my ISK here.
emails.backend_status: Transfer received 14 Nov; holdings booked 15 Nov.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The transfer of your ISK was received on 14 November and the holdings were booked on 15 November. You can see them in the app now. We are sorry for the wait. If you are not satisfied with this decision, you can ask our Kundombudsman (Customer Ombudsman) to review it, and after that apply to ARN (Allmänna reklamationsnämnden, the National Board for Consumer Disputes).

emails.subject: Account closed by the bank without explanation
emails.body: The bank has given notice that my account will be closed. I have been a customer for twenty years and nobody can tell me why.
emails.backend_status: Closure notice sent 4 Nov after an account-measure review; customer not given the reason or a contact. Review standard: confirm with the bank.

emails.subject: Card transactions I did not make, not refunded
emails.body: I reported two transactions I did not make on 11 November. I was told I would get the money back. Nothing yet.
emails.backend_status: Reported 11 Nov; refund due by the next business day (Payment Services Act) and not yet credited.

emails.subject: Bolån redemption papers delayed
emails.body: Writing for the borrower. Access day is next week and the estate agent still has no redemption papers for the bolån.
emails.backend_status: Requested 6 Nov; day 5 of the bank's 5-business-day standard (confirm with the bank).

emails.subject: Why has my account been frozen
emails.body: My salary account has suddenly been blocked for payments out and Swish does not work. The kontor told me to write. My rent is stuck.
emails.backend_status: Account-measure review opened 11 Nov; no decision yet. Review standard: confirm with the bank.
emails.theme_label: Account measures: frozen or restricted accounts

emails.subject: Scam reported in October, no decision
emails.body: I reported a manipulated transfer on 20 October. Two follow-ups later I have no decision. I will take this to ARN if it is not resolved.
emails.backend_status: Investigation open since 20 Oct; past the 15-business-day investigation standard (bank standard, confirm with the bank).
emails.theme_label: Manipulated transfers and Swish fraud handling

emails.subject: Complaint closed without resolution, third time
emails.body: This is the third time my complaint has been closed without anything being fixed. The fee is still on my statement.
emails.backend_status: Closed twice without a refund; fee still charged.

emails.subject: Loan application stuck for two weeks
emails.body: I applied for a privatlån on 30 October and signed with BankID. The app still says it is being processed.
emails.backend_status: Application waiting for a manual income check since 3 Nov; past the bank's 3-business-day loan-decision standard (confirm with the bank).

emails.subject: Card application status
emails.body: I applied for a credit card ten days ago. The status in the app says it is being processed. How much longer?
emails.backend_status: Checks complete; approval expected 17 Nov.

emails.subject: Refund still not received
emails.body: The shop refunded my purchase on 5 November. It still has not reached my account.
emails.backend_status: Refund received from the card network 14 Nov; credit in the next posting run.

emails.subject: Payment to my builder not received
emails.body: I paid my builder through Bankgiro on Thursday and he says the money has not arrived.
emails.backend_status: Payment held for a fraud check 13 Nov; released 14 Nov, 15:20; credited the same day.

emails.subject: Package fee charged twice
emails.body: The monthly fee for my bank package was taken twice in October.
emails.backend_status: Duplicate fee refunded 12 Nov; customer not yet informed.

emails.subject: Cannot log in to the app
emails.body: I have a new phone and cannot log in to the app with BankID. Reinstalling did not help.
emails.backend_status: Device registration reset 13 Nov; customer logged in 13 Nov, 19:14.

emails.subject: Annual statement for my ISK
emails.body: I need a statement of the ISK standard tax (schablonskatt) for my tax return.
emails.backend_status: Statement published in the internet bank 13 Nov.

emails.subject: Insurance in my savings that I did not ask for
emails.body: My savings were moved into a product with insurance and a monthly fee. I never agreed to it.
emails.backend_status: Change recorded at an adviser meeting; the savings and funds product owner to review the advice.

emails.subject: Too many sales calls
emails.body: I receive loan offer calls every week after using the app. How did they get my number and how do I stop them?
emails.backend_status: Consent and preference records sit with Compliance.
